author: HCDE
text:
I think it is time for me to come in and try to input some ideas on that matter.

Some months ago, i asked a question on the forum, and IF answered.HCDE wrote: Hi everyone.

I'm still working on some theory stuff about RTMA PART1 and i'm a bit
stuck on some part so i submit some sketchs to you to have your advices
on that subject.

This is about price behavior inside targets and the clue it gives us on the future:

Thanks for your lights!

Ifmyante wrote: First, we must dissect the kink, and mark all the clean orders in it.

Then we watch the approach for distinct stop hunts into these levels.

We can trade each and any of them, taking profits to cover trips to the next sets of clean orders.

Say our first minor set of clean orders breaks. Price will, sooner or
later get to the next one. It could first retrace for ten pips, or ten
thousand. But it will get there. So, essentially, our minor level hasn't
 turned price.

Can you think of a way to manage a trade taken at a kink which broke,
allowing for no loss and the possibility of a giant retrace?

I didn't understand it back then, but now i do. And it helped me to understand a recent loss that was a wonderful enigma to me.

I charted everything: See next post, forum don't let me put it all in one...
